subject: Ops steerboard briefing: scope trade + dependency sourcing for QBR prep
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Ops steerboard briefing: scope trade + dependency sourcing for QBR prep

Team —

Quick steer ahead of tomorrow's sync. Execs want a concise list of: 1) where we plan to trim scope for Q4, 2) the cross-team dependencies that must be sourced, and 3) any procurement or vendor blockers that need leadership escalation. High-level asks below; please reply inline by EOD so I can consolidate a 1-page readout for the steerboard.

Top-level context: Arcadia Health (pilot) is considering a Dedicated commitment for next year; procurement + security have open asks that affect our go/no-go timeline. We need a recommended scope line and an explicit dependency list to present.

Proposed agenda items for the readout (please confirm):
- Recommended scope trim (two options: A = preserve X latency work, trim Y integrations; B = trim X and reallocate to Optimize backlog)
- Critical dependencies (Infra: GPU capacity + autoscale policy; Product: API stable contract for reranking endpoints; Security: SOC evidence for data residency)
- Procurement touchpoints and ETA (Arcadia procurement has an internal review on 11/12)

Specific asks (reply with names/dates):
1) Karthik — can you confirm infra ETA for the extra 2 p100 nodes we proposed and whether we can set a soft SLA before QBR?
2) Laura — need a short blurb on which API contracts would be treated as breaking for customers vs internal (1 paragraph).
3) Markus — if we go with scope A, what is the incremental SRE footprint (headcount or effort hours) required?
4) David — can you coordinate with Arcadia on procurement contact and get me the DocuSign timeline today?

I'll stitch responses and circulate the one-pager. Attachments: I uploaded an initial appendix with a dependency matrix (QBR-steer-appendix.pdf).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Ops steerboard briefing: scope trade + dependency sourcing for QBR prep

Vanessa —

I'll take point on procurement outreach. I already have Sarah Lee (Arcadia) on a quick thread; copying her separately below so everyone has the contact. I'll confirm the DocuSign timeline today and push procurement@arcadiahealth.org for the earliest review slot.

I'll also flag any compliance evidence they request — if it's SOC2 or encryption attestations we'll need an expedited read from Security (I'll ping them if needed).

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ops steerboard briefing: scope trade + dependency sourcing for QBR prep

David / Vanessa —

Infra status and dependency notes (short):
- Extra capacity: We can provision 2x p100 nodes in the us-west cluster by 2026-11-12 if procurement approves the quota bump today. Lead time is primarily quota + billing approval; engineering work to onboard is ~16 engineer-hours (SRE + infra dev).
- Soft SLA: we can stand up a best-effort latency target for the pilot (SLO: 95th <= 160ms for 2k qps) but it will require the p100 nodes and enabling continuous batching. Acceptable as a pilot guarantee, not enterprise SLA yet.
- KV cache dependency: Product needs to freeze the API for reranking endpoint (v2) by 11/10 so we can validate consistent cache keys. Laura — we'll need that contract paragraph by EOD 11/5.
- Security evidence: SOC2 Type II artifacts exist; however, Arcadia is asking for data residency proof. Security will need the customer region and a signed DPA.

Attachments: uploaded a revised dependency matrix (dependency-matrix-v2.xlsx) to the drive link.

Action items I took: open quota ticket with cloud provider (INF-9482), stubbed DOC for soft SLA language (drive link).

Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@arcadiahealth.org>

Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Ops steerboard briefing: scope trade + dependency sourcing for QBR prep

Hi David / Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the quick coordination. A few notes from Arcadia's side:
- Procurement is available to review the Dedicated commitment on 11/12; they need the SOW + pricing and the DPA executed beforehand.
- Security: our security lead needs the SOC2 packet and a network topology that shows data is seated in us-west; can Redwood provide the topology and the HSM/KMS spec?
- On capacity: procurement is comfortable with the pilot nodes if the soft SLA is documented; they'll sign off conditioned on the DocuSign timeline and a named escalation contact at Redwood.

I'll route this to procurement and confirm the 11/12 slot if you can get the SOW + DPA to procurement@arcadiahealth.org by COB 11/10.

Best,
Sarah Lee

Arcadia Health
